descriptions.preferred: 'Orangeola' is noted for the bright orange-red spring foliage. The leaves turn a rich red-green, still with an orange flush, throughout the summer, boosted by a second flush of orange-red leaves in midsummer, then becoming dark red before turning fiery orangered in the fall. The large fiveto seven-lobed leaves are deeply divided to the base, and each lobe is itself deeply incised. The red leafstalks are short and slender. Although vigorous growing, this cultivar is one of the smaller dissectums, barely more than 10 ft. (3 m) high when fully grown. It forms an attractive cascading mound, five usually taller than wide. tapering stalks

rhs.description: 'Orangeola' is a mound-forming, deciduous shrub or small tree to around 3m tall. Its arching branches bear finely-cut leaves that emerge orange-red in spring, darkening to a reddish-green in summer before turning a brighter orange-red in autumn. Small red flowers may be followed by winged fruits in autumn

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 'Orangeola' 为丛生拱垂型落叶灌木或小乔木，高约 3 米。 其弓形枝条着生细裂叶，春季展叶为橙红色，夏季加深为带红调的绿色，秋季再转为更鲜亮的橙红色。 小型红花之后，秋季可能结翅果。

attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Orangeola' 以春季鲜亮的橙红色新叶而著称。 叶片在整个夏季会转为浓郁的红绿色，但仍带有橙色晕染；盛夏还会再抽生一轮橙红色新叶，入秋前先变为深红，随后在秋季转成火焰般的橘红色。 其大型叶片通常为 5 至 7 裂，深裂近基部，每个裂片又进一步深刻。 红色叶柄短而纤细。 虽生长势较强，但该品种在 Dissectum 类群中仍属较小型，完全成熟时高度仅略超过 10 英尺（3 米）。 株形呈优美的垂枝堆丘状，通常高大于宽。 'Oregon Sunset' 属 Matsumurae Group，红叶品种。 该品种叶姿优雅、色彩丰富，形成小型、整齐、紧凑的圆头灌木状树形，春秋叶色尤为出众。 新叶柔和红色，很快转为李子红；秋季则变为鲜艳的晚霞红。 叶片较大，通常深裂为 5 至 7 个狭长卵形裂片，每个裂片具细长尖端。 叶缘具许多细密、尖狭的锯齿，裂片尖端略向下弯，如舒展下垂的手指。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Orangeola' Orangeola Weeping Laceleaf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Orangeola’ is a beautiful multi-colored pendulous dissectum Japanese maple. ‘Orangeola’ is one of the most cascading Japanese maples. The heavily pendulous branches bear leaves that have shades of orange, red and green. The new growth emerges as a brighter red to orange as the older growth below is green. This creates a dynamic contrast and makes this Japanese maple truly special. The fall color of 'Orangeola' is bright tones of orange-red. ‘Orangeola' is a vigorous Japanese maple tree that typically grows about 4 ft by about 5 ft wide in 10 years. This is an excellent tree in the landscape but its beauty can also be utilized as a container plant for porches or patios.
